title: Earlier turns keep their reasoning and calls; the reasoning-only sets (D2, P4)
request: From Hermes Agent the owner wants a reasoning-only training set beside the full one: 'build two sets from the same records: one with real thinking (teaches why), one with every run (teaches tool use); don't mix empty thinking into the first'. The audit of 2026-10-23 found every earlier assistant turn of a kept exchange labelled 'its thinking was not kept', its tool calls dropped, and no example naming the tools offered.
spec: Plan D2 whole step record, package P4 (plans/yes-you-are-right-jaunty-parasol.md): from_exchange keeps each earlier turn's reasoning (the field P1 sends back, or Anthropic's thinking blocks) and tool calls (object arguments), tool turns their call id, the example its tools; the folders reasoning (M4) and trajectories/reasoning (M5) hold examples whose every turn or tool step is recorded; the stage sets to v2, studio to v3.
plan: read from_exchange, intern_trajectories, build's placement and write_set's versions
earlier_reasoning and earlier_calls: an earlier turn as the agent sent it back
all_recorded: the reasoning-only rule, never an empty, a visible, a rule's or a teacher's reasoning
the two folders in build, from the same examples; a clean answerer only for M4's
the version moves and the tests

decisions.decision: An earlier turn's reasoning comes from the message as sent back (reasoning_content, reasoning, thinking_blocks), never from another exchange
decisions.why: the exchange is the one record of what the model saw; stitching turns across exchanges would invent a context

decisions.decision: M4's reasoning-only folder takes a clean answerer's exchanges only
decisions.why: a provider's model's runs are evaluation and silver until the owner's D11; an exchange naming no model is not clean either

decisions.decision: M5's reasoning-only folder is built from studio's placed rows only
decisions.why: studio already holds clean, verified, newest-per-table runs; the reasoning folder adds the thought rule, nothing else

decisions.decision: The stage sets move to v2 and studio to v3
decisions.why: their content changed (earlier turns whole, thoughts with sources, failed runs apart); keep_sealed carries every earlier version's sealed rows

decisions.decision: The tools on an intern trajectory stay empty for now
decisions.why: the session keeps no schemas and the run record only their hash; the exchange log has them, keyed by request, which the session builder does not join yet

change: dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (earlier_reasoning, earlier_calls, all_recorded, from_exchange with tools and tool_call_id, the folders REASONING and TRAJECTORIES_REASONING in build, versions, abouts), tests/test_store_sets_llm.py, tests/test_store_m5_trajectories.py.

findings.defect: every earlier assistant turn of an exchange was labelled 'its thinking was not kept' and lost its tool calls
findings.scenario: a local model's second turn: the reasoning it sent back under reasoning_content was in the kept messages and still unused
findings.cause: from_exchange read only the final reply's thinking
findings.fix: earlier_reasoning and earlier_calls on every assistant turn
findings.impact: the workflow LLM's examples taught one thinking turn per exchange

findings.defect: a bare model name counts as a provider's: the first test named a local model without its Ollama tag and the reasoning folder stayed empty
findings.scenario: model 'qwen3.6-35b-a3b' is frontier:unknown by answerer_of's rule; 'qwen3.6:35b-a3b' is local
findings.cause: the rule judges a model local on its name's evidence only
findings.fix: the tests name the model as Ollama does; the rule is kept (never clean by default)
findings.impact: none in code; a lesson for the tier's model name

findings.defect: an earlier turn's tool-call arguments, one JSON string under a key the shaper reads as no words, reached train unredacted and unseen by the sealed-text guard
findings.scenario: an earlier ask_user call whose question quoted a sealed journey's sentence and an address: both in the stage set and the reasoning set, nothing kept out
findings.cause: earlier_calls parsed the string after the shaper; texts_of read content and reasoning only
findings.fix: earlier_calls redacts every string of the parsed arguments; texts_of gives the guard every message's tool calls
findings.test: tests/test_store_sets_llm.py (the mailed and the sealed call)
findings.impact: a sealed person's words and personal data in a training set (new with P4: before, earlier calls were dropped)
alternatives: add arguments to TEXT_KEYS (the shaper then redacts a tool's code arguments too, the known separate issue)

findings.defect: sealed once, sealed always broke across folders: keep_sealed read only the same folder's earlier versions, and the reasoning folders had none
findings.scenario: a session sealed in studio v1 (split by session) on a train table: studio v3 sealed, trajectories/reasoning train
findings.cause: the reasoning lists were filled at build time, before the parents' sealed rows were carried
findings.fix: the reasoning sets are derived from their parents after keep_sealed, then carry their own earlier versions
findings.impact: a sealed row in a training folder

findings.defect: a local model served by MLX or vLLM is named mlx-community/... or Qwen/..., which answerer_of files as a provider's: never clean, its runs silver
findings.cause: the rule judges by the name alone
findings.fix: mlx-community/ added to the local prefixes as a stopgap; the endpoint's host on the exchange and the session is the follow-up
findings.impact: the reasoning sets stay empty for a vLLM-served local model until the follow-up
alternatives: record the tier's provider and host with every exchange (a store and capture change)
findings.open: the endpoint's host on the record

findings.defect: the earlier-turn test did not cover a clean model's exchange with no reasoning on its earlier turn
findings.scenario: home_agent was kept out for lacking a model, not by the every-turn rule
findings.fix: a partial exchange: in its stage set, not in the reasoning set

measurements.name: the M4 and M5 set tests
measurements.gate: every test passes; studio's verified rows unchanged under v3
measurements.result: every test in the three store set files passed
measurements.next: make capture, then the counts of reasoning and trajectories/reasoning; the full gate tonight
limits: no real local-model exchange exists yet (P1 ships the field): the reasoning folders fill after the owner's first local run

outcome: A kept exchange's every assistant turn carries the reasoning and the calls it sent back, its tool turns their call id, the example the tools offered; the reasoning-only sets hold the examples whose every turn or tool step was recorded, by clean answerers only.
lessons: Name a local model as its server names it (an Ollama tag): the store judges an answerer by that name alone.
risks: the M4 stage sets still take every exchange, a provider's model's included, with consent train: that predates P4 and is the owner's to decide against the silver rule
an intern trajectory's tools stay empty until the session builder joins the exchange log's schemas
